controller.observed_change: Tier2 guard v11 restores fail-closed requirement for an independently durable carrier and forbids source/carrier snapshots, snapshot-derived Sandbox.create, Sandbox.fork and persistent:true for Tier2 credit

sources.finding: sandbox snapshots are tied to the lifecycle of the sandbox that created them; sandbox-independent persistence should use a Vercel Drive

Vercel Drive has a lifecycle independent from any sandbox, remains after sandbox deletion, and can be mounted by a later sandbox; Drives are private beta and require an enabled Pro/Enterprise project plus the beta Sandbox SDK/CLI
Drive.getOrCreate plus Sandbox.create mounts are the provider-supported independent-storage mechanism in the beta SDK

adjudication.reason: deleting the old Sandbox must not delete the only recovery carrier; provider primary sources state snapshots belong to the producing Sandbox lifecycle
adjudication.drive_reason: provider documents Drive as storage whose lifecycle is independent of any Sandbox and mountable by a later Sandbox

vercel_control_plane_observation.note: No runtime or build credit transfers from older deployments to controller head 8aeec51d.

next_exact_isolated_step: Do not weaken the Tier2 guard. First establish whether Vercel Drives beta is enabled/authorized for the current project and whether the retained controller may move to the beta SDK. If admitted, use one temporary integrity-bound Drive as declared transfer carrier: source Sandbox exports only the logical state/workspace/exact OCI transfer bundle to the Drive, unmounts, source Sandbox is deleted, a genuinely new persistent:false Sandbox mounts the same Drive, verifies hashes/manifest/exact OCI identity, restores under a new generation, then the Drive is deleted after a bounded recovery receipt. If Drives are unavailable, select another already-authorized sandbox-independent durable store with equivalent lifecycle and integrity properties.
